messages:
zoe.engineer: Quick q: I'm planning a 4-week remote work stint in Lisbon (2026-08-01 to 2026-08-28). Is our WFH stipend paid when you're temporarily abroad? Also can I have a spare monitor shipped there or should I request reimbursement?

maria.peopleops: Please fill the temporary remote form (https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/forms/temp-remote) and choose 'personal travel'. For 4 weeks we prorate the monthly stipend by calendar days in the payroll month. Shipping reimbursement is usually preferred over direct shipment to avoid customs delays; submit a ticket to IT and mark expense as 'temp-remote-shipping'.

rafa.tax: Tax note: 4 weeks is usually under most residence thresholds, but Portugal has specific rules if you provide services to local entities. If all work is for Redwood and no local invoicing/clients, it's low risk. Keep travel logs and copies of your form. If you have any meetings with local partners, let us know.

it-asset-bot: Asset guidance: company monitors can be checked as temporary transfers. Use the asset portal to log: https://assets.redwood/checkout. Do not ship devices via untracked courier.

zoe.engineer: Thanks 60a submitted form TR-2026-0899 and filed an IT ticket for reimbursement.
